description: Voice cases: whether drafts avoid the patterns of machine-written text, describe mechanisms instead of slogans, and use the person and register that fit the reader, in Italian and English. Cases 1 and 2 are sections of a real client document that the team rejected.

evals.name: it-offer-review-delivery
evals.prompt:
Sto scrivendo un'offerta per Cliente Esempio S.p.A. su un pilota di sviluppo assistito dall'AI. La sezione qui sotto così non va bene: riscrivila. Usa solo i fatti presenti, senza aggiungerne. Restituisci solo la sezione in Markdown.

### 5.4 Review, test e delivery

Niente va in produzione senza controlli e senza l'approvazione di A&D. Ogni modifica, scritta a mano o con l'AI, passa da test, controlli automatici e review.
evals.expected_output: An Italian section that describes the release process step by step (tests, automated checks, review, A&D approval before production) without a motto, in the third person or impersonally, with no invented facts.
assertions: The opening sentence describes a step or an actor, not a motto built on niente, nessuno, ogni or sempre
Keeps every supplied fact: A&D approves before production; tests, automated checks and review; applies to code written by hand and with AI
Adds no tool, number, role or step that is not in the source
No first person plural (noi, nostro, verbs ending in -iamo)
No em or en dash
No sentence opens with Ogni, Niente or Nessun
No colon setup that announces an inline list (as in 'segue lo stesso percorso: test, ...')
Written in Italian

evals.name: it-offer-context-harness
evals.prompt:
Sezione di uno studio per Cliente Esempio S.p.A. sull'adozione dell'AI nello sviluppo. Il tono non mi piace, queste frasi mi snervano. Riscrivila senza cambiare i fatti e senza aggiungerne. Solo la sezione, in Markdown.

### 5.2 Contesto, specifiche e harness

Il progetto smette di vivere nella testa delle persone. Scriviamo nel repository architettura, convenzioni, comandi, test e aree protette in AGENTS.md, valido per ogni strumento, così le scelte architetturali diventano ADR.

Costruiamo o adattiamo skill e plugin per le attività di sviluppo ricorrenti, con un catalogo versionato che il team mantiene, e lavoriamo su contesto, scelta del modello e sessioni per ridurre i consumi non necessari.

La telemetria misura anche gli interventi sull'harness: confrontiamo i consumi su attività comparabili e verifichiamo che l'ottimizzazione conservi la qualità del risultato. Consegniamo un pacchetto harness per il pilota, con playbook, profilo organizzativo e istruzioni di installazione.
evals.expected_output: An Italian section that opens on what is written in the repository, uses SparkFabrik or an impersonal subject instead of 'noi', explains each activity concretely, and keeps every fact.
assertions: No metaphor or slogan opener such as 'il progetto smette di vivere nella testa delle persone'
No first person plural (scriviamo, costruiamo, lavoriamo, confrontiamo, consegniamo, noi, nostro)

Keeps every supplied fact: AGENTS.md in the repository with architecture, conventions, commands, tests and protected areas, valid for every tool; architectural choices as ADR; skills and plugins with a versioned catalog the team maintains; work on context, model choice and sessions to reduce consumption; telemetry compares consumption on comparable tasks and checks that quality is preserved; harness package for the pilot with playbook, organizational profile and installation instructions
Adds no fact that is not in the source
No colon setup that hangs an explanation on a colon (as in 'La telemetria misura anche gli interventi sull'harness: confrontiamo')
No em or en dash
SparkFabrik is not the subject of more than one sentence
Written in Italian

evals.name: it-offer-draft-monitoring
evals.prompt: Scrivi la sezione "Monitoraggio e reperibilità" di un'offerta per Comune di Esempio. Fatti: monitoraggio con Prometheus e Grafana su tutti gli ambienti; alert su Slack e via telefono per la reperibilità; reperibilità 24/7 per gli incidenti P1, con presa in carico entro 30 minuti; report mensile con disponibilità e incidenti; il cliente nomina un referente tecnico. Solo la sezione, in Markdown, in italiano.
evals.expected_output: An Italian offer section that states each service with its tool, time and owner, in the third person or impersonally, bolding the key items, without slogans or marketing words.
assertions: No first person plural (noi, nostro, verbs ending in -iamo)
No slogan or motto sentence (for example 'nessun incidente resta senza risposta')

Keeps every supplied fact: Prometheus and Grafana on all environments; alerts on Slack and by phone; 24/7 on-call for P1 incidents; taken in charge within 30 minutes; monthly report with availability and incidents; client names a technical contact
Adds no number, tool or service level that is not in the source
No marketing words (robusto, eccellenza, all'avanguardia, chiavi in mano, a 360 gradi)
Bold marks the key items a skimming reader must catch (tools, times, P1)
Adds no explanation of what a tool does (for example what Prometheus or Grafana are for)
No colon setup that hangs an explanation on a colon in running prose (`**Label:** text` list items are the house form and are fine)
No em or en dash

evals.name: en-pr-export
evals.prompt: Draft only the PR description. The reports page gets a CSV export button. The download keeps the current filters and date range. It exports the same table you see, it's not a new report. Validated on staging with a 10,000-row report. No template, no attribution, do not post.
evals.expected_output: A short PR description that states the export and what it keeps, plus the validation, without antithesis or colon setups.
assertions: Body stays within 80 words
No antithesis such as 'it's not a new report, it's the same table' or 'not X but Y'
No colon setup such as 'The result: ...'
Keeps the staging validation with 10,000 rows
Adds no behavior that is not in the source
Says the export is the same table shown on screen
No em or en dash

evals.name: it-slack-colleague
evals.prompt: Scrivi il messaggio Slack per il canale del team piattaforma. Abbiamo spostato la pipeline di build sui nuovi runner. Il job di build ora dura 4 minuti invece di 12. Domani alle 10 passiamo in produzione se i test notturni restano verdi. Serve che Marco controlli i permessi del service account entro stasera. Solo il testo del messaggio.
evals.expected_output: A short Italian Slack message from a teammate, in the first person, that leads with the update and makes Marco's action easy to spot.
assertions: Written in Italian
Uses the first person or the team's voice, not SparkFabrik in the third person
The first line states the update
The request to Marco, with its deadline, stands out (bold or its own line)
Keeps 4 and 12 minutes, tomorrow at 10, and the nightly tests condition
Stays within 80 words
The first line is a full sentence, not a label ending in a colon
No closing one-liner or slogan

evals.name: en-client-incident-email
evals.prompt: Write the email to Laura Bianchi, IT lead at Acme Pharma, about yesterday's incident. Facts: the customer portal was unavailable from 14:10 to 14:52 CET on 2026-10-30. The cause was an expired TLS certificate on the load balancer. The certificate was renewed at 14:50. We are adding an alert 30 days before any certificate expires, in place by 2026-11-06. No data was lost. Give the subject line and the body only.
evals.expected_output: A plain email that states the impact and time window first, then cause, fix and next step with its date, addressed to Laura, without minimizing or marketing.
assertions: Impact and time window appear in the first two sentences of the body
Addresses Laura by name
No minimizing words (only, brief, minor, small, just)
No marketing or reassurance slogans (for example 'your trust is our priority')
Adds no fact that is not in the source
Makes no commitment the source does not contain (for example a promise to write again)
No em or en dash

evals.name: en-upstream-drupal-comment
evals.prompt: Write my comment for a drupal.org issue in the Search API module queue. I reproduced the bug on 8.x-1.38 with PHP 8.3. The facet count is wrong when a filter uses OR. Patch #12 fixes it for me and its tests pass locally. I'd suggest adding a kernel test for the OR case. Comment text only.

Does not mention SparkFabrik or promote a company
Keeps 8.x-1.38, PHP 8.3, patch #12 and the kernel test suggestion

No label-style opener such as 'Suggestion:' or 'Reproduced:'
No em or en dash

evals.name: en-readme-internal-deploy
evals.prompt: Write the 'Deploy' section of our internal platform runbook README. We deploy with Terraform first, then Helm. The Terraform state lives in a GCS bucket that only the platform team can write. The clusters run in us-east-1 and europe-west1. If a deploy fails, ask in #support-infra-platform. The rollback steps for each service, with the person who approves them, are listed further down. Section only, Markdown.
evals.expected_output: A short internal README section in the team's voice or in the imperative, with identifiers as code and no slogans.
assertions: Does not refer to SparkFabrik in the third person; first person or imperative is fine
Shows us-east-1 and europe-west1 as code
Keeps the order Terraform then Helm, the bucket write restriction, the support channel and the pointer to rollback steps
Paragraphs have three sentences or fewer
No slogan opener or closing one-liner
No colon setup that announces a sentence (a colon before a bulleted or numbered list is fine)
No em or en dash

evals.name: it-offer-sparkfabrik-sprawl
evals.prompt:
Nella bozza dell'offerta per Cliente Esempio S.p.A. "SparkFabrik" compare troppe volte, quasi in ogni frase. Rivedi queste sezioni per togliere le ripetizioni inutili, senza cambiare i fatti e senza aggiungerne. Restituisci solo le sezioni riviste, in Markdown.

### 3. Ruoli

- **SparkFabrik:** conduce il pilota, prepara la baseline e affianca il team di Cliente Esempio nelle attività tecniche.
- **A&D (Cliente Esempio):** approva i rilasci in produzione e decide sugli strumenti da adottare.

### 4. Avvio

Con il referente tecnico, SparkFabrik raccoglie l'elenco dei repository, gli strumenti AI in uso e i vincoli di sicurezza. Il pilota parte dalla migrazione dei repository scelti, con il supporto di SparkFabrik.

### 5. Attività

Nella baseline SparkFabrik fa un audit degli strumenti AI in uso e delle loro configurazioni, e verifica quali impostazioni sono gestite centralmente. SparkFabrik aiuta poi a configurare l'esportazione della telemetria e a costruire cruscotti sui consumi.

SparkFabrik aiuta il team a impostare una pipeline di CI che esegue test e controlli automatici su ogni modifica. SparkFabrik aiuta A&D a definire, e poi verificare in pipeline, cosa può andare in produzione. SparkFabrik valuta con A&D un gateway per l'accesso ai modelli.

### 6. Formazione

SparkFabrik forma referenti interni che seguono il team dopo il pilota.

### 7. Esperienza SparkFabrik

Nell'ultimo anno tutta SparkFabrik è passata allo sviluppo assistito dall'AI. Il playbook di SparkFabrik descrive le pratiche adottate, e SparkFabrik è membro di CNCF.

### 8. Avanzamento

Ogni settimana SparkFabrik fa il punto con il referente tecnico.
evals.expected_output: The same sections with SparkFabrik named in the roles, where it distinguishes roles, and in the experience section; elsewhere the activity, the client's team or an impersonal form is the subject, decisions keep A&D as owner, and no vague stand-in replaces the name.
assertions: SparkFabrik appears at most 6 times
The roles section still names SparkFabrik and A&D with their responsibilities
The experience section still names SparkFabrik at least once
Does not replace SparkFabrik with a vague stand-in such as 'l'azienda', 'il fornitore' or 'il partner'
Decisions keep their owner: A&D still approves releases and takes part in the gateway evaluation
Does not move work from SparkFabrik to the client's team (for example 'il team configura l'esportazione' where SparkFabrik helped)

Keeps every supplied fact: repository list, AI tools and security constraints collected with the technical contact; migration of chosen repositories; audit of AI tools and configurations; centrally managed settings; telemetry export and consumption dashboards; CI pipeline with tests and automated checks; what can go to production defined and verified in the pipeline; gateway for model access; internal contacts trained; AI-assisted development across the company in the last year; playbook; CNCF membership; weekly check-in with the technical contact
Adds no fact that is not in the source
No first person plural (noi, nostro, verbs ending in -iamo)
No em or en dash

evals.name: it-offer-draft-roles

Fatti: SparkFabrik guida il progetto e fornisce due platform engineer; il team IT del Comune gestisce i server attuali e approva i rilasci; si parte da un assessment dei 12 servizi in esercizio; poi si costruisce un cluster di staging; si migrano i servizi uno alla volta, con test di carico prima di ogni passaggio in produzione; il team IT riceve formazione su Helm e sul monitoraggio; ogni due settimane c'è una revisione con il responsabile IT. Solo le due sezioni, in Markdown, in italiano.
evals.expected_output: Two Italian sections: roles that name SparkFabrik and the IT team once with their responsibilities, then activities whose subjects are the activities or the IT team, with SparkFabrik named only where it distinguishes roles.
assertions: SparkFabrik appears at most 3 times
The roles section names SparkFabrik and the IT team of the Comune with their responsibilities
The IT team stays the owner of release approval
Does not use a vague stand-in such as 'l'azienda', 'il fornitore' or 'il partner'

Keeps every supplied fact: two platform engineers; 12 services; assessment; staging cluster; one service at a time; load tests before each production step; training on Helm and monitoring; review every two weeks with the IT manager
Adds no fact that is not in the source
No first person plural (noi, nostro, verbs ending in -iamo)
No em or en dash
